title: Los Alamos disinformation as a model for secret programs
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Los Alamos disinformation as a model for secret programs, about 1940s at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You have duplicitous filings. For example, they didn't want people to know that plutonium and uranium were the two main radioactive elements that they were focused on.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher, points to Los Alamos, the New Mexico lab where the US built the atomic bomb in the 1940s, and cites the scientist Harold Urey. He says the project used misleading paperwork so that outsiders would not learn that plutonium and uranium were the two radioactive elements it cared about most. He offers it as a model for how a secret programme today, including one about UFOs, might hide what it is really doing.
